products.note: Humanoid robotics AI; physical world interaction; safety-critical; embodied AI governance

profile_text.body:
Figure AI describes itself as a first-of-its-kind AI robotics company focused on building a general-purpose humanoid robot. The company's stated mission centers on bringing a physical humanoid to life, positioning its work at the intersection of artificial intelligence and embodied robotics for real-world interaction.

The site's held facts categorize Figure AI's core product within emerging and frontier AI, with noted emphasis on physical world interaction, safety-critical systems, and embodied AI governance. No litigation, SEC filings, patent records, or MCP server registrations are present in the current data.
